15408540.content:
1.7. How does one pronounce Debian and what does this word mean?
The project name is pronounced Deb'-ee-en, with a short e in Deb, and emphasis on the first syllable.
这种有官方说明的，一般我都是按官方说明来读。
除了 MySQL ，官方建议读音是 My-S-Q-L ，我还是习惯读 My-sequel 。
